review.small_factory: Official OfflineRecognizer.from_paraformer with factory arguments and PCM conversion matching the original adapter. The original adapter is not modified or used for the small candidate; native compatibility still requires this board test.

sequence.repeat_scope: Each engine recognizes the same eight fixtures twice in one process, allowing first and repeated decode to be distinguished. No extra reverse-order processes in this initial screen.
sequence.order_limit: Fixed engine order and any background activity change must be reported; this screen is not a strictly controlled A/B speed claim.

parent_runner_requirements: Current boot/startup/config/source identity and current GUI/camera process births must pass owner's existing guards before any action.
Pause microphone only while dialogue and generation are idle; preserve current production processes, identity policy, queue sizes, camera, display and memory behavior.
Validate staged model, worker, helper and public fixture hashes before child execution.
Use existing board Python and sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 dependencies; run only one additional recognizer process at a time.
Actually enforce the external 180-second child timeout, terminate and reap only the owned child on timeout; passing --external-deadline-managed alone is insufficient.
Keep total paused-listening test window bounded to 600 seconds; abort remaining slots if budget or runtime guards fail.
Record per-slot before/after process CPU, memory and background state without collecting private text or audio; no claimed controlled speed gain if background changes materially.
Restore original automatic listening in finally, verify mic=true and WAITING_SPEECH, and save a restore observation even when inference fails.
No production model replacement, reboot, dependency install, priority or affinity change, live microphone replay, playback, Store action or private database export.
report_requirements: Save a RESULT_HANDOFF.json with exact result paths and hashes, finished/failed/skipped slots, child exit status, measured background changes and restore evidence.
Separate resource validation/import/load from per-utterance decode wall and CPU; do not add model loading to steady-state ASR latency.
Report first model decode and later cases separately; peak RSS is the whole isolated child, not model-only memory.
Compare each model against the same eight public WAV hashes. References are authored synthesis intents, not human-gold transcripts.
Review names, numerals, negation, correction, remember and forget wording in paired hypotheses; literal edit distance is descriptive and does not establish semantic failure for numeric normalization.
Treat public offline test results as screening evidence only; full production dialogue latency, continuous capture stability and real speech accuracy remain unverified.
Do not compare against a prior production version as a controlled baseline; both engines in this pair must share the same unchanged current configuration.
